alternative_hypothesis: H1: each active strength axis has a reproducible local robustness basin around its default; the conditional third-axis zero endpoint is equivalent to the reset-all baseline; response curves are smooth enough for registered quadratic diagnostics in log2 multiplier space.
assumptions: The catalogue trefoil loaded by the registered KnotPlot executable is an admissible fixed initial topology for this numerical sensitivity experiment.
A fixed bead count of 300 is a discretization control, not a swept relaxation variable.
The zero multiplier is an endpoint control and is excluded from log2 and polynomial fits.
The third strength axis is disabled by reset-all defaults, so its magnitude sweep is conditional on enabling that force while all non-strength controls remain untouched.
A PASS is a statement about KnotPlot numerical relaxation robustness only, not physical SST stability.
edge_cases: m=0 is not assigned a log2 coordinate and is excluded from polynomial fits.
The conditional third-axis reference uses that force enabled at m=1 and is not interchangeable with reset-all baseline except at the registered m=0 equivalence control.
Quadratic fit quality is diagnostic and cannot by itself promote KnotPlot relaxation to a physical stability claim.
A topology-changing or failed KnotPlot run is an acquisition failure even if a coordinate file exists.

equations.dimensional_check: p_k has the same units/internal parameter dimension as p_0.
Logarithm argument and result are dimensionless.
Both curves are normalized by radius of gyration; D_shape is dimensionless.
inputs: arclength-resampled centered Rg-normalized closed curves X and Y

equations.dimensional_check: Each ratio compares equal-dimension quantities and is dimensionless.
x and D_shape are dimensionless; coefficients are dimensionless.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any expected campaign coordinate is missing, empty, non-finite or unparsable.
The positive multiplier ladder is not exactly quarter-octave spaced or reciprocal about m=1.
The conditional third-axis m=0 endpoint differs from reset-all baseline by D_shape>1e-8 or registered scale-free scalar relative error>1e-10.
For either always-active strength axis, a one-step perturbation m=2^(+/-1/4) produces D_shape>0.005 relative to m=1.
No extreme condition produces D_shape>1e-5 relative to its axis-specific m=1 reference.
C++ FP64 coordinate-metric parity exceeds relative error 1e-12.

null_hypothesis: H0: at least one active strength axis is locally non-robust around its default, or the response cannot be treated as a smooth default-centered strength-response curve under the registered single-trefoil protocol.
objective: Measure trefoil shape response to one-at-a-time default-relative strength perturbations on a quarter-octave log2 ladder, distinguish the exact-zero endpoint from finite log-space samples, test the conditional zero-strength equivalence of the otherwise-disabled third axis, certify coordinate-derived metrics in C++ FP64, and classify the local default neighborhood without varying any other relaxation control.

observables.definition: Exact 101-condition campaign structure, ladder reciprocity and quarter-octave spacing.
Coordinate completeness and finite-geometry validity at all six checkpoints.
Final shape/scalar response versus each axis-specific m=1 reference, including the zero endpoint.
Quadratic response diagnostics on the registered local log2 window |x|<=1.
Python FP64 versus C++ FP64 coordinate metric parity.

predictions: The quarter-octave ladder will produce uniform x=log2(m) samples from -4 to +4.
The exact-zero endpoint of the conditional third axis should reproduce reset-all geometry if the enable switch only gates that force term.
If defaults lie inside a numerical robustness basin, one-step reciprocal perturbations around m=1 should produce small D_shape.
Strong departures at large |x| may reveal saturation, alternate relaxation basins or interaction with untouched default integrator/displacement controls.
research_question: For a single trefoil geometry, how do three anonymous KnotPlot relaxation-strength axes change the relaxed shape when sampled on an exactly log2-symmetric multiplier ladder around each runtime-declared default while all other relaxation settings remain at reset-all defaults?

steps.operation: Verify the retained historical trefoil script, runtime executable identity, campaign manifest and exactly 101 successful KnotPlot conditions.
Verify the generated positive ladder has x=k/4, reciprocal pairs and a separate exact-zero endpoint; parse every registered coordinate checkpoint.
Compute final default-relative shape and scale-free scalar responses for every anonymous strength axis and quantify endpoint liveness.
Leave independent held-out physical confirmation disabled unless a separate source is introduced in a future version.
Certify registered coordinate-derived scalar metrics with instance-local C++17/pybind11 FP64 against Python FP64.
Leave GPU screening to framework profile semantics; do not repurpose the G6 lane.
Do not treat conditions from one KnotPlot executable as independent cross-source replication.
Evaluate the local default neighborhood, conditional zero-equivalence control, reciprocal response asymmetry and registered quadratic log-response diagnostics without changing the frozen thresholds.
Reveal strength-axis semantics only after commitment verification; blind multiplier statistics remain unchanged.
